Name: Functional Candy Machine Mod
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
[b]✨ Abrah’s Candy Machine ✨[/b]
Turn your farmhouse into a sweet wonderland with the [i]Candy Machine[/i]! This adorable pastel themed big craftable dispenses random handmade candies every morning. 
[line]🍬 [b]What It Does: [/b]Place the Candy Machine anywhere on your farm or inside your house, and each day it will produce one random candy from a colorful selection of 11 unique flavors. Every candy is fully consumable and sellable.
[line]🍭 [b]Candy Selection[/b][list]
[*]Mint Candy – cool and refreshing
[*]Grape Candy – juicy and purple
[*]Bubble Gum Candy – chewy and sweet
[*]Strawberry Candy – bright and fruity
[*]Chocolate Orange – cocoa with a citrus twist
[*]Lemon Candy – zesty and tangy
[*]Caramel Candy – buttery chew
[*]Watermelon Candy – summery and fresh
[*]Apple Candy – crisp and juicy
[*]Coconut Candy – creamy tropical flavor
[*]Blueberry Candy – rich and berry-sweet
[/list]Each candy sells for [b]80–90 g[/b] and restores a small amount of energy when eaten.
[line]🛠 [b]Requirements[/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/b] (latest version)
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿[/b] (required)
[/list][quote][b]PFM is [i]not[/i] required.[/b]
The Candy Machine works entirely through Content Patcher’s data edits and will function without Producer Framework Mod.[/quote][line]🏠 [b]Where to Find It[/b][list]
[*]Visit [b]Robin’s Carpenter Shop[/b] — the Candy Machine is listed for [b]0 g[/b] under her shop menu.
[*]Once purchased, you can place it indoors or outdoors.
[/list][line]📦 [b]How to Install[/b][list=1]
[*]Download and install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b] if you haven’t already.

[*]Download [b]Abrah’s Candy Machine (CP)[/b].

[*]Unzip the folder and place it inside your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] directory.

[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.

[*]Head to Robin’s shop and claim your Candy Machine!

[/list][line]💖 [b]Details[/b][list]
[*]Type: [b]Big Craftable / Decorative Machine[/b]
[*]Produces: [b]One random candy per day[/b]
[*]Placement: [b]Indoor & Outdoor[/b]
[*]Price: [b]Free (0 g at Robin’s)[/b]
[/list][line]🌸 [b]Credits
[/b]Created by [b]AbrahMods[/b]
